channel.title: The Alien's Guide to Earth
channel.description: New pages and corrections from The Alien's Guide to Earth: the great investors and traders, their ideas in plain words, every claim sourced. Education only, not investment advice.

item.title: Correction (Paul Tudor Jones): The flagship fund's lower-return period now reads 2008 to 2016 (about 4.7% a year), not 20…
item.description: The flagship fund's lower-return period now reads 2008 to 2016 (about 4.7% a year), not 2008 to 2015. Why: The Bloomberg report we cite is dated 1 August 2017 and covers 2008 'through last year', which is 2016.

item.title: Correction (Paul Tudor Jones): Removed 'tripled his money' for 1987; the page now gives the reported 125.9% gain after fe…
item.description: Removed 'tripled his money' for 1987; the page now gives the reported 125.9% gain after fees. Why: A 125.9% gain is about 2.3 times, not three; the same page already gave 125.9%.

item.title: Correction (Paul Tudor Jones): Replaced a dead CNN link for Black Monday with a 24/7 Wall St article giving the same figu…
item.description: Replaced a dead CNN link for Black Monday with a 24/7 Wall St article giving the same figures (2,246.73 to 1,738.74, down 22.6%). Why: The original page now returns 'not found'.

item.title: Correction (Paul Tudor Jones): '14 for 14' years up now says that 1990 covers July to December only.
item.description: '14 for 14' years up now says that 1990 covers July to December only. Why: The fund started in July 1990, so the first year is a part-year.

item.title: Correction (Paul Tudor Jones): Added the January to April 2004 return (+8.56%, our calculation) to the year-by-year table…
item.description: Added the January to April 2004 return (+8.56%, our calculation) to the year-by-year table. Why: The row showed the account value but no return for the part-year.

item.title: Correction (Mark Minervini): The 220% a year figure now notes that his book describes five years (33,500% in total) whi…
item.description: The 220% a year figure now notes that his book describes five years (33,500% in total) while Jack Schwager describes about five and a half years from mid-1994. Why: The two sources describe slightly different periods; we now show both.

item.title: Correction (the whole site): Plain pages now show charts and tables that match the interactive pages, and no longer men…
item.description: Plain pages now show charts and tables that match the interactive pages, and no longer mention charts that were not on the page. Why: Found in an independent review of the site.

item.title: Stanley Druckenmiller: new trader page
item.description: Ran George Soros's Quantum Fund, came up with the 1992 bet against the pound, and reported about 30% a year at his own fund without a losing year. One plain-English page: the big ideas, short quotes with sources, a special section, a self-test and a reading plan. Education only, not investment advice.

item.title: Mark Minervini: new trader page
item.description: Lost all his capital in the 1980s, then studied history's biggest winning stocks and won the U.S. Investing Championship twice, in 1997 and 2021. One plain-English page: the big ideas, short quotes with sources, a special section, a self-test and a reading plan. Education only, not investment advice.

item.title: Paul Tudor Jones: new trader page
item.description: Lost most of his clients' money on one cotton trade in 1979, built his rules around defence, and made a reported 125.9% after fees in 1987, the year of the crash. One plain-English page: the big ideas, short quotes with sources, a special section, a self-test and a reading plan. Education only, not investment advice.
